comment: Phase 3 api-key route, JWKS-validation variant. Mirrors 00-mcp-apikey.json (mcp-apikey-primary) but validates the inbound token LOCALLY via jwks-token-validation.groovy instead of introspection, selected by the BFF's X-Token-Validation: jwks header (ff_mcp_gateway_jwks). Name 'mcp-apikey-jwks' sorts before 'mcp-apikey-primary' (IG selects by name, not filename) so it wins when the header is present; absent header → its condition fails and mcp-apikey-primary (introspection) matches. McpValidationFilter buffers the body for p1az-decision + the apikey-dispatch handler.
name: mcp-apikey-jwks
condition: ${find(request.uri.path, '^/mcp/apikey') and not empty request.headers['X-Token-Validation'] and request.headers['X-Token-Validation'][0] == 'jwks'}
